evals.prompt: I uploaded a revision PDF. Give me the original MCQs from pages 3-4 exactly as written, with answer choices, and do not show answers yet.
evals.expected_output: Questions preserve source wording, numbering and options; source pages are identified; no invented content; answers are withheld.

evals.prompt: How many questions have I actually solved? We discussed 10 worked examples but I only submitted answers to 4 MCQs.
